title: Clean up a date

public.summary: Convert dates typed any old way into one standard format — and refuse to invent one.
public.goal: Lumen's notification service receives dates in whatever format a customer typed. Write a prompt that converts the date in the message to YYYY-MM-DD and returns {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Ambiguous numeric dates use the Indian convention, day first. If no specific calendar date can be determined, return {"date": null}.
public.exampleInput: Your onboarding slot is confirmed for 14th Aug '25.
gradedOn: Returns only the JSON object, nothing around it
The date is converted correctly, reading numeric dates day-first
Returns null instead of guessing when a date is relative or doesn't exist
